notes: Aligned to hub/score_schema.md §2.1 contract. The hub reads this file to evaluate C_engine: for each signal, a fired record in engine/fired_signals.json (id + strength + ts) is decayed by half_life_hours and weighted. min_confidence is the engine's own gate for publishing a fired record; thresholds are the fire conditions. Weights sum to 1.0. DRAFT until calibration (§7 of score_schema.md) moves them.

signals.label: fresh graduation / new pool
signals.data_source: gmgn-cli token info (open_timestamp, launchpad_status, migrated_pool) + GeckoTerminal pool_created_at
signals.rationale: Tokens that just opened for trading (pump.fun bonding-curve fill / fresh pool) are the rawest early-entry universe; crowd volume arrives minutes later. Lead time measured in backtest.md §3.

signals.label: bundler / sniper preload
signals.rationale: High bundler-trade share at launch = bots loaded before the crowd. Historically precedes the FOMO leg; also a rug-watch flag (bundlers that dump instantly disqualify).

signals.label: volume before price
signals.data_source: gmgn-cli token info (price.volume_5m, price.buy_volume_5m, price.sell_volume_5m, price.buys_5m, price.sells_5m)
signals.rationale: Rising volume BEFORE the price move (not after) is the signature the doctrine asks for: accumulation shows up in volume first. Backtest: volume-leads-price gap in §3.

signals.label: dev still holding
signals.rationale: Dev sells are the #1 early-kill risk. Dev still holding (status='hold') removes the dump-the-rug failure mode; direction is +1 only when holding, and a dev dump at any point is a hard veto downstream (gate, not score).

signals.label: healthy holder spread
signals.rationale: Early pumps show a distinctive top-10 concentration curve: it dilutes as the crowd arrives. Sub-35% top-10 (and <10% dev team) at the same moment volume starts rising = distribution, not accumulation trap. Above 35% → risk flag, not a buy.
